Here are some essential summer tips for pet owners to keep your furry friends safe and comfortable:
1. Hydration is Key
• Always provide fresh, cool water.
• Bring water on walks or outings.
• Consider ice cubes as a fun treat.
2. Avoid Midday Heat
• Walk pets early morning or late evening.
• Hot pavement can burn paw pads — test it with your hand.
3. Never Leave Pets in Cars
• Even with windows cracked, temperatures can soar in minutes.
• It’s life-threatening — never risk it.
4. Provide Shade & Cool Areas
• Offer shaded outdoor spots or let them stay inside with a fan or AC.
• Cooling mats or damp towels help lower body temp.
5. Watch for Signs of Overheating
• Panting, drooling, lethargy, vomiting, or collapse are red flags.
• Heatstroke can be fatal — seek a vet immediately if suspected.
6. Protect Against Parasites
• Use flea, tick, and heartworm preventatives.
• Check for ticks after walks or hikes.
7. Keep Grooming Up to Date
• Regular brushing helps remove excess fur.
• Don’t shave dogs without a vet’s advice — fur can protect against sunburn.
8. Safe Splashing
• Supervise pets around pools or lakes.
• Rinse off chlorine or salt after swimming.
